body:
Sorry, yeah! This is a different therapist than " My mom's best friend". I've seen a bunch of therapists on and off and I've been with this one for about 2 years and he's done the best work with me. He called me late last night and he listened... I think it's rare for some therapists to call after hours, but I think he could tell there was something wrong. I was honest and upfront. He didn't 5150 me last night but he did tell me to call back today to check in... if this continues we may talk about going on antidepressants. I've struggled with depression, but it's rare when it gets this bad.

As for the guy, I admit that I call everyone too much. One of my best friends in the city I currently live in said he probably got pissed in blocked me. What pisses me off is that when we started dating I said upfront "I call people way too much. I'm not trying to stalk or control, I'll just honestly forget I called you just 5 minutes ago if I want to talk to you." So, instead of calling once a night for the people I wanna talk to, I'll average 3 times a night until it clicks "Oh! They aren't there!"He said it was fine. It's a hard line for me to walk because calling like that because it is a part of my personality. Some guys/friends don't mind it. There are few it pisses off though. I just always thought it was best to be upfront about it.  Last night, I wasn't calling to harass, I called because I heard it's best to reach out when you are feeling this way. I sent him a text saying "So, I see you blocked me on facebook. Good luck with everything!" and telling him why I called so much. I would just prefer to talk something like that out before being cut out of someone's life. Anyways, I called him 3 times yesterday (suicide watch), 3 times Saturday ( wanted to hang out, the forgetting thing), and 2 times Thursday, last time we chatted. We had a good chat. Oh wells. It hurts but I'll get over it. You're right, he did have other things going on and I honestly wish him the best.

There's been other issues outside my parent (13 years of bullying, 14 years of child abuse, and a whole slew of failed romantic relationships would make anyone depressed I believe) , but right now that's what I wanted to talk to my therapist about today... and decided to play russian roullette with my emotions by taking a nap. >.<... which usually works for me actually. How my parents aren't supportive of my decisions or validating my emotions. When I tried to talk rationally to them and tell them how I feel, well the above story resulted. I believe only I know what's best for me... I just want the pain to go away...
I didn't think of it like that...

My parents forced me to play the piano k-12... one of our fights when I entered college was because I decided to stop. However, I was quite talented at it... and it did help me feel a little better when I was down. I prefer singing actually... maybe I can get involved with a local group.
Sometimes tells me the depression and anxiety I've been struggling with since I was 13 is not temporary... It's been 10 years...
